title: Everything in its right place: attention is a radio head
abstract: arXiv:2611.13146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention, the core of language models, is a digital calculation over tokens: an exponential selects them, a division normalizes and a positional code sets the order. We show that attention can instead emerge from the synchronization of a receiver with its context tokens. Each past token is an oscillator whose state carries its content and whose frequency drifts with its age. The present token selects them by content, aligning an antenna with its query, and by position, setting the frequency of a receiver with its dial. Solving Kuramoto's problem for this receiver yields an attention layer in closed form with two phases: above a critical coupling set by the context, the receiver locks and its weights normalize; below it, it stays silent and its weights sum to less than one. translated_title: 万物各归其位：注意力是一个无线电接收头
translated_abstract: 注意力是语言模型的核心，是一种基于词元的数字计算：指数函数负责选择词元，除法负责归一化，位置编码负责设定顺序。我们证明，注意力也可以从接收器与其上下文词元之间的同步中涌现。每个历史词元都是一个振荡器，其状态携带自身内容，其频率随着“年龄”增长而漂移。当前词元通过内容进行选择——将天线与查询对齐；也通过位置进行选择——用调谐旋钮设定接收器的频率。对该接收器求解Kuramoto问题，可以得到一个闭式解的注意力层，它具有两个相位：当耦合强度高于由上下文设定的临界值时，接收器进入锁定状态，其权重被归一化；低于临界值时，接收器保持静默，其权重之和小于一。经过训练的网络利用这两个相位来实现选择、弃权和计数，在理论所预测之处失效，并能持续读取远超训练长度的序列。注意力的每一部分……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出注意力机制可以从物理同步中涌现——把历史词元建模为频率随时间漂移的振荡器、把当前词元建模为无线电接收器，通过求解Kuramoto同步问题闭式导出一个具有“锁定/静默”两相的注意力层，从而将Transformer注意力重新解释为无线电调谐接收过程，并自然实现选择、弃权、计数及超长序列泛化。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that attention can emerge from physical synchronization: modeling past tokens as age-drifting oscillators and the present token as a radio receiver, solving Kuramoto's problem yields a closed-form attention layer with locking and silent phases that can select, abstain, count, and read far beyond the training length.
